artifacts.summary: The certificate wire format now has a canonical printer and a total parser proved inverse to it, so deserialization has left the trust base.

completion_data.completion_summary: Replaced the certificate wire codec with a two-layer verified one: a canonical JSON printer plus a total (non-partial) fuel-indexed parser in BimodalTools/CanonicalWire/, and a schema encode/decode pair over it. All nine pinned theorems are proved -- including parse_print (parsing a printed certificate returns that same certificate) and print_parse_canonical (on canonical bytes the echo is byte-identical to what was sent) -- with zero sorry and no new axiom. All twelve recorded parser defects are closed by negative #guards, the envelope is migrated, and the output line carries an echo of what was parsed.

review_reason: Three pinned Lean Challenge statements were corrected rather than proved as recorded, because each is false as written: unescape_escape now names the closing quote that unescapeBody consumes, and parseCJson_printCJson and parseCJson_fuel_sufficient each carry one added hypothesis (NoDigitHead rest -- printCJson (.int 1) ++ ['2'] is the byte string 12). Per .claude/rules/plan-compliance.md's Statement Fidelity section an added hypothesis is a reviewable event even when the recorded statement was the wrong one. Every other check passes: zero sorry, no new axiom, full gate set green.

user_decision.question: Three recorded Lean Challenge statements are false as written (unescape_escape omits the closing quote that unescapeBody consumes; parseCJson_printCJson and parseCJson_fuel_sufficient are false at the integer leaf, since printCJson (.int 1) ++ ['2'] is the byte string 12). options: Accept the corrected statements as landed and amend the plan's Lean Challenge block to match, recording why each recorded form was false
